description: Greenery and emission sources around a point (a home): tree canopy share within 300 m, green land share and summer NDVI within 500 m with a low/medium/high level against the rest of the city, the nearest park, up to 10 emission sources (power plants, works and mines within 5 km, landfills within 3 km, boiler houses and single chimneys within 1.5 km) chosen by significance (high/medium/low, from emissions, fuel and size) and distance, with distance, bearing, fuel, confidence, significance, wind_exposure (the share of the time the wind blows from the source to the home, from the wind rose of the region) and, for facilities in the Climate TRACE registry, yearly CO2e, and the number of detached houses within 1 km (an estimate of stove smoke, not a count of stoves). Only computed cities; elsewhere the error city_not_covered.
name: get_home_environment
title: Surroundings of a home
